summary.text: Sapaskis is a Bronx-based Republican making his second run for NY-15 after losing to Torres in 2022; he has also run for New York State Senate in 2010 and New York City Council in 2025. His campaign centers on inflation, a higher minimum wage, more police presence, and financial aid for higher education.

paragraphs.text: According to a voter-guide profile, he holds an Associate of Applied Science in Corporate Cable Communications from Borough of Manhattan Community College and a B.A. in Film Production/Cinema Studies from the City College of New York; and is pursuing an M.F.A. in the same field at the New York Institute of Technology.
Ran for New York State Senate in 2010 as the Republican nominee, unopposed in the primary, and lost the general election to Adriano Espaillat.
Ran for NY-15 in 2022, losing to Ritchie Torres 82.7%-17.2%.
Ran for New York City Council District 11 in 2025 as the Republican nominee, receiving 13.0% against incumbent Eric Dinowitz in the general election.
Became the Republican nominee for NY-15 in 2026 after the June 23 Republican primary was canceled.
